title: The Station Workbench
prompt: Use Dazzler to design the station workbench for its fictional reader task. A horizontal station strip sits above a side-by-side reading and exception workbench; units and operating limits remain explicit. Retain the existing data and functional controls, with keyboard and mobile access. Use Archivo, #934100 and #FFFFFF. Preserve factual caveats and local-only behavior; do not imply real booking, payment, publication or account changes.
